audio.strategy: Phase 2 plays a bundled recorded sample library for Grand, Upright, and Electric; Clav/Digital/Misc and the labeled fallback are honest runtime synthesis. One deterministic render pipeline (src/audio/render.ts + src/audio/effects.ts + src/audio/dsp.ts) serves both the browser and tests: the Web Audio backend pre-renders each voice through the exact graph (layer source → Mod 1 → Mod 2 → Delay → Amp/EQ/Filter → Compressor → per-voice frames) and plays it through layer buses, a live convolver reverb, layer level gains, master gain, and a DynamicsCompressor limiter to one destination; the fake test backend runs the identical code offline. Reverb and Rotary run live in the browser so mixes stay correct; reverb always precedes rotary. Master Level rides the master gain with click-free ramps.

notes: One AudioContext: voice sources → per-layer buses → ordered effects → layer level gains → master gain (Master Level knob) → limiter → one destination. Bypass is click-free; parameter changes use short ramps.
Delay feedback filtering is inside the feedback loop (repeats progressively filtered, dry path untouched). Reverb precedes Rotary; To Rotary taps post-reverb, pre-layer-level.

Functional controls (Piano, Layer Effects, Master Level, Panic) write canonical engine state via src/state/panel-bindings.ts; every other control remains decorative (presentation state only), asserted by tests.
String Res is a simulated sympathetic-resonance wash (spec allows simulation); Soft Release is disabled for Clav per manual p. 25.
Per-layer polyphony 16 voices with deterministic stealing; blur/disconnect/unmount/panic stop every owned voice; tests assert voice/timer/listener baselines.
Sustain works from UI, computer keyboard (space), and MIDI CC64, and only affects layers with SUSTPED on.
